body: I encourage people to run home and steal. What am I?
I engulf you in darkness but you see many things. I can be resisted but a lack of me leaves rings. What am I?
I fall but I never get hurt. What am I?

I fall from the sky but am not rain. I like the cold and not the sun. People like to eat me. What am I?
I fasten it and it walks. I unfasten it and it stops. What is it?
I fill a room but take no space. What am I?
I flow from the mouth of Homer when he sees doughnuts. What am I?
I fly away as soon as you set me loose. People around you may slowly move away once they sense my presence. What am I?
I fly but have no wings. I cry but have no eyes. I see the sky get dark and I see when the sun comes up. What am I?
I fly forever, Rest never. What am I?
I fly in the air without engines and am controlled by man on the ground. What am I?
I fly through the air on small feathered wings, seeking out life and destroying all things?

I fly to any foreign parts, assisted by my spreading wings. My body holds an hundred hearts, Nay, I will tell you stranger things when I am not in haste I ride and then I mend my pace anon. I issue fire from my side. You witty youths, this riddle con?
